newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 7-THURSDAY, JANUARY 16.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 7-THURSDAY, JANUARY 16.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, JANUARY 7

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-316/95 Generics: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36 - Patent law - National rule conferring on the holder of a pharmaceutical patent the right to oppose for the duration of the patent the presentation of samples by a third party to the authority charged with registering drugs. Court injunction addressed to a counterfeiter banning, after the expiration of the present patent, the marketing of products currently under patent protection. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-349/95 Loendersloot: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 36 - marketing within the community of alcoholic beverages with the title-holder's brand on the bottles and packaging. Exercise of brand name law to prevent third parties from removing marks of identification placed by the brand holder that allow him to recognise breeches in the distribution system and oppose parallel imports of his products.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-292/95 Spain v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of July 6, 1995, extending retroactively from January 1, 1995, the decision of December 23, 1992, on the community framework of state aid in the automobile sector.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 8

COURT OF JUSTICE, SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-330/95 Goldsmiths: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 11, part c, point 1 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Reduction in cases of partial non-payment. Power of a member state to provide for a reduction in the base rate in cases where the counterpart is a sum of money, but to exclude such reductions otherwise. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-104/96 Cooperative Rabobank "Vecht en Plassengebied": company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 68/151/EEC of March 9, 1968, on the coordination of safeguards which, for the protection of the interests of members and others, are required by member states of companies within the meaning of the second paragraph of EC treaty article 58, with a view to making such safeguards equivalent throughout the community. National regulation on the representation of a company in cases of a conflict of interest. Statutes providing for the non competence of an administrator to engage the company in such cases. Possible opposition of third parties.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 9

COURT OF JUSTICE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-225/95, C-226/95, C-227/95 Kapasakalis: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 89/48/EEC of December 21, 1988, on a general system for the recognition of higher-education diplomas awarded on completion of professional education and training of at least three years' duration. Breech by a member state of the obligation to transpose the directive. Damages to individuals.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-255/95 Agri: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 3(c) of Council regulation 797/85 of March 12, 1985, on improving the efficiency of agricultural structures. Aids towards the extension and intensification of bovine meat production. Condition for granting. Bovines. Reduction of livestock.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-272/95 Deutsches Milch-Kontor: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9, 12, 16 and 95 as well as of article 2 of Commission regulation 1624/76 of July 2, 1976, on special arrangements for the payment of aid for skimmed-milk powder denatured or processed into compound feeding stuffs in the territory of another member state as amended by Commission regulation 1726/79 of July 26, 1976. Aid measures and special sales operations for skimmed-milk powder for use in feed. Quality and composition control of the product. Frequency of controls carried out by samples. Inspection fees charged to the exporter.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-323/95 Hayes: principles of community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 7. National legislation imposing on foreigners bringing a court action the payment of a "cautio judicature solvi". - Oral procedure C-299/95 Kremzow: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 5 and 6 of the European Convention of Human Rights. Community nature of provisions. Effect of the finding by the European Court of Human Rights of a breech of the convention. - (0930/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-Moksel: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 9, paragraph 2 and article 8, paragraph J of Commission regulation 3665/87 of November 27, 1987, laying down common detailed rules for the application of the system of export refunds on agricultural products. Export refunds. Bovines originating in the former German Democratic Republic found in the German Federal Republic before the economic and monetary union between the two Germanys, for slaughter and export towards the Soviet Union. Export after unification.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-143/95-P Commission v/ Socurte: social policy. Appeal against Court ruling of March 7, 1995, rendered in joined cases T-432/93, T-433/93, T-434/93, Socurte, Quavi and Stec v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment by which the Court of First Instance annulled the Commission decision reducing the financial contribution of the European Social Fund to a professional training programme. Notification instigating the appeal period. Information on the motives and meaning of a decision. Right of the member state involved to present its observations before the ESF takes a negative decision. Article 6 of the regulation 2950/83 of October 17, 1983, implementing decision 83/516 concerning ESF's missions. - Judgment C-383/95 Rutten: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 5, point 1 of the Brussels Convention. Work contract to be executed in several contracting states. Place where the worker usually performs his work. - Opinion C-136/95 Thibault: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1, paragraph 1, 2, paragraph 1 and 4, 5, paragraph 1 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Collective convention by virtue of which maternity leave can automatically result in diminished chances for promotion. - Oral procedure C-90/94 Haahr Petroleum: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9 to 13, 84 and 95. National regulation on tax on the use of public and private commercial ports affecting national products and imports. Supplementary tax of 40 percent on imported goods only. - Oral procedure C-114/95, C-115/95 Texaco: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9 to 13, 18 to 29, 86, 90 and 96. Interpretation of Council regulation 4055/86 of December 22, 1986, on the principle of the freedom to offer services to maritime transport between member states and between member states and third countries and of regulation 4056/86 of December 22, 1986, on the modes of application of articles 85 and 86 on the maritime transport treaty. Interpretation of accords on free trade between Sweden and the EU and Norway and the EU. National regulation on tax on the use of public and private commercial ports affecting national products and imports. Supplementary tax of 40 percent on imported goods only. - Oral procedure C-242/95 GT-Link: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9 to 13, 74 to 84 and 95. Interpretation of articles 35 to 37 of the 1972 Membership act. National regulation on tax on the use of public and private commercial ports affecting national products and imports. Supplementary tax of 40 percent on imported goods only. Exemption to the benefit of vessels belonging to the company and assimilated vessels. National taxes incompatible with community law. - Oral procedure C-110/95 Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 3(b), 8, 9 and 19 of Council regulation 1768/92 of June 18, 1992, on the creation of a supplementary protection certificate for medications. Granting of a supplementary protection certificate in a member state other than the one that authorised the marketing of the product.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, JANUARY 14-16
TUESDAY, JANUARY 14

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-124/95 Centro-Com: commercial policy. Judgment C-169/95 Spain v/ Commission: state aid. Judgment joined cases C-192/95, C-193/95, C-194/95, C-195/95, C-196/95, C-197/95, C-198/95, C-199/95, C-200/95, C-201/95, C-202/95, C-203/95, C-204/95, C-205/95, C-206/95, C-207/95, C-208/95, C-209/95, C-210/95, C-211/95, C-212/95, C-213/95, C-214/95, C-215/95, C-216/95, C-217/95, C-218/95, Comateb: principles of Community law. - Opinion C-180/95 Draehmpaehl: social policy. - Opinion C-310/95 Road Air: external relations. - Oral procedure C-408/95 Eurotunnel: taxation.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-128/95 Fontaine: competition.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 15
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-158/96 Kohll: free movement of persons. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-212/96 Chevassus-Marche: free movement of goods.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-81/95 Interhotel v/ Commission: social policy.
THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-77/95 SFEI v/ Commission: competition.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 16
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-57/95 France v/ Commission: company law.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-114/94 IDE v/ Commission: company law.
THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-273/95 Buratti: agriculture.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-164/95 Fabrica de Queijo Eru Portuguesa: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-94/95, C-95/95 Bonifaci: social policy. - Opinion C-258/95 Julius Fillibeck Soehne: taxation. - Opinion C-260/95 DFDS: taxation. - Opinion C-261.95 Palmisani: principles of Community law. - Opinion C-373/95 Maso: social policy. - Opinion C-197/96 Commission v/ France: social policy. - Oral procedure joined cases C-248/95, C-249/95 SAM Schiffahrt: transport. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure joined cases C-370/95, C-371/95, C-372/95 Careda: taxation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-134/95 USSL no 47 de Biella: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-147/95 Evrenopoulos: social policy. - Opinion C-351/95 Kadiman: external relations. - Opinion C-23/96 Commission v/ France: approximation of legislation. - Opinion C-135/95 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. - Oral procedure C-400/95 Dansk Handel and Service: social policy. - (1015/0915 GMT) Oral procedure C-165/95 Lay: agriculture. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-114/96 Kieffer: free movement of goods.
